canonical_statement: For every complete, injective, positive-multiplicity enumeration of the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function ordered by nondecreasing absolute imaginary part, and every real x > 1 which is not a prime power, Chebyshev psi(x) is the limit of x minus the multiplicity-weighted sum of x^rho/rho, minus log(2*pi), minus one half log(1-x^(-2)).
domain_and_universes: E : NontrivialZeroEnumeration; x : Real; all declarations live in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: x is not p^k for any prime p and positive natural k
E enumerates exactly the zeta zeros rho with 0 < re(rho) < 1
E assigns every enumerated zero its positive meromorphic order as multiplicity and has no duplicates
E is ordered by nondecreasing abs(im(rho))
conclusion: The stated complex partial sums tend to the real value Chebyshev.psi x embedded in Complex.
endpoint_convention: Mathlib Chebyshev.psi is right-continuous; the root excludes prime-power discontinuities, so no half-jump term is needed.
zero_sum_convention: Multiplicity-weighted partial sums use an injective complete enumeration ordered by nondecreasing absolute imaginary part.
